Question ID: ANP_U03_L06_GP_Q01

Guided practice item 1.
Lesson focus: Sliding Filament Muscle Contraction
Stimulus: Contraction sequence model

A student is reviewing the required visual and must explain the first visible structure-function connection. Which answer uses the lesson evidence most accurately?

generalfeedback.text: Teachable feedback: First, begin with calcium exposure of binding sites.
